The 111 names the engineering protocols use, each declared once in [`protocols/vocabulary.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/vocabulary.yaml) with its category, its marking and its meaning. The vocabulary holds names and what they mean; what a claim, a piece of evidence or an obligation is, and how one is decided, belongs to Canon.

- **`core`**: not specific to Git, pull requests or code; usable by every engineering protocol.
- **`software.change`**: only makes sense for Git, pull requests or code.

## Artifact kinds

Category `artifact_kind`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `intent` | `core` | what the change or response is meant to achieve |
| `system_specification` | `core` | the specified behaviour of the system concerned |
| `plan` | `core` | the intended steps toward the intent |
| `release` | `core` | a versioned, deployable unit of the system |
| `deployment` | `core` | a release running in an environment |
| `service` | `core` | the running service a case concerns |
| `implementation` | `software.change` | a revision of the code that realizes the plan |
| `experiment_design` | `core` | the metrics, splits, seeds and success criterion an experiment is run under |
| `dataset_snapshot` | `core` | the frozen data an experiment's runs read |
| `baseline` | `core` | the reference model or method a candidate is compared with |
| `candidate` | `core` | the model or method under test |
| `run_configuration` | `core` | the settings and environment an experiment's runs used |
| `results` | `core` | the metrics an experiment's runs produced |
| `eval_design` | `core` | the evaluation design an automated loop is tuned under, its splits, metrics and guards |

## Evidence kinds

Category `evidence_kind`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `operational_observation` | `core` | an observation of the running system |
| `objective_observation` | `core` | an observation of whether the intent's objective is met |
| `impact_assessment` | `core` | an assessment of who and what an incident affects |
| `cause_analysis` | `core` | an analysis of why an incident happened |
| `test_result` | `software.change` | the result of running tests against an implementation revision |
| `code_review` | `software.change` | a review of an implementation revision |
| `build_provenance` | `software.change` | the record of how a release was built from an implementation |
| `rollback_result` | `core` | the result of returning to a previous release, complete or partial |
| `design_review` | `core` | a review of an experiment design, passed or failed |
| `integrity_check` | `core` | a check of the runs behind a set of results for integrity violations, clean or violated |
| `reproduction` | `core` | a rerun on the same dataset snapshot and run configuration, matched or diverged |
| `comparison` | `core` | a comparison of a candidate with the baseline, candidate\_better or baseline\_better |
| `seed_sweep` | `core` | a sweep of a candidate's effect over seeds or ablations, stable or unstable |
| `regression_test_result` | `software.change` | the result of running a bugfix's regression test against an implementation revision |
| `implementation_change` | `software.change` | the record that the implementation was changed, moving it to a new revision |
| `security_review` | `software.change` | a review of an implementation revision's effect on a security boundary |
| `guard_check` | `core` | a check of a candidate against the surface a loop may change and for leaked or forbidden content, outside, leaked or clean |
| `tuning_comparison` | `core` | a first and a second run of a candidate against the baseline on the tuning split, reproduced, not\_reproduced or not\_better |
| `heldout_comparison` | `core` | a run of a candidate against the baseline on the held-out split, held or regressed |

## Claims

Category `claim_id`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `release.proven` | `core` | the release comes from a verified implementation and carries current build provenance |
| `deployment.healthy` | `core` | the deployment is running healthily |
| `objective.realized` | `core` | the intent's objective is met |
| `impact.bounded` | `core` | the incident's impact is known and contained |
| `service.healthy` | `core` | the service is running healthily |
| `cause.identified` | `core` | the incident's cause is known |
| `tests.pass` | `software.change` | the tests pass for the current implementation revision |
| `implementation.reviewed` | `software.change` | the current implementation revision is reviewed |
| `implementation.verified` | `software.change` | the current implementation revision is verified |
| `experiment.valid` | `core` | the experiment design passed review and the results carry no integrity violation |
| `result.reproducible` | `core` | a reproduction of the current results matched them |
| `candidate.beats_baseline` | `core` | a comparison of the current candidate found it better than the baseline |
| `effect.robust` | `core` | a sweep of the current candidate found its effect stable |
| `hypothesis.supported` | `core` | the experiment is valid and reproducible, and the candidate beats the baseline robustly |
| `regression.reproduced` | `software.change` | a failing test has reproduced the regression a bugfix repairs |
| `regression.shown_first` | `software.change` | a bugfix's regression test failed on its first run, before the implementation was first changed |
| `security.reviewed` | `software.change` | the current implementation revision's security review is approved by another principal than the implementer |
| `rollback.verified` | `core` | the release's rollback is complete, by a rollback result from another principal than the one who rolled it back |
| `change.within_surface` | `core` | an independent guard check did not find the current candidate outside the surface the loop may change |
| `content.clean` | `core` | an independent guard check found the current candidate free of expected answers and new forbidden content |
| `tuning.improved` | `core` | an independent first run of the current candidate on the tuning split was better than the baseline |
| `heldout.not_regressed` | `core` | an independent run of the current candidate on the held-out split did not regress against the baseline |
| `change.supported` | `core` | every keep claim holds for the current candidate revision |

## Actions

Category `action_id`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `metrics.inspect` | `core` | read the system's metrics |
| `logs.search` | `core` | search the system's logs |
| `release.inspect` | `core` | read what a release contains |
| `release.rollback` | `core` | return to a previous release |
| `traffic.shift` | `core` | move traffic between deployments |
| `emergency.leave` | `core` | leave emergency mode |
| `repository.inspect` | `software.change` | read the repository |
| `repository.merge` | `software.change` | merge a revision into the repository's mainline |
| `tests.run` | `software.change` | run the tests against an implementation revision |
| `tests.write` | `software.change` | change the tests in the repository's working revision |
| `implementation.edit` | `software.change` | change the implementation in the repository's working revision |
| `design.review` | `core` | review the evaluation design, under authority |
| `candidate.evaluate` | `core` | check and run the current candidate revision, producing its guard check and comparisons |
| `change.keep` | `core` | keep a candidate a loop produced, on every keep claim and authority to keep |
| `change.reject` | `core` | discard a candidate once every keep claim is decided and one is false |
| `change.propose` | `core` | hand a candidate that leaves the loop's surface to a person as a proposal, applying nothing |
| `change.apply_outside_surface` | `core` | apply a candidate that leaves the loop's surface, under a capability never granted to a loop |

## Obligations

Category `obligation_id`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `restore_service` | `core` | bring the affected service back to health |
| `investigate_cause` | `core` | establish why the incident happened |
| `tests.required` | `software.change` | the tests must pass for the current implementation revision |
| `review.required` | `software.change` | the current implementation revision must be reviewed |
| `provenance.required` | `software.change` | the release must be proven, its build provenance recorded |
| `health.required` | `core` | the deployment must be observed healthy |
| `red_first.required` | `software.change` | a bugfix's regression test must fail on its first run, before the implementation is first changed |
| `security_review.required` | `software.change` | a change that affects a security boundary must be security reviewed by another principal than the implementer |

## Outcomes

Category `outcome_id`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `accepted` | `core` | the case closed with its result accepted |
| `declined` | `core` | the case closed on a decision not to carry out its intent |
| `rolled_back` | `core` | the case closed with its release returned to a previous one |
| `superseded` | `core` | the case closed on a decision that another case replaces it |
| `abandoned` | `core` | the case closed on a decision to stop before it reached any planned outcome |
| `supported` | `core` | the case closed with its hypothesis supported |
| `refuted` | `core` | the case closed with its hypothesis refuted by a valid, reproducible result |
| `invalid_experiment` | `core` | the case closed because its experiment is not valid |
| `inconclusive` | `core` | the case closed on a decision that its experiment settles nothing |
| `kept` | `core` | the case closed with its candidate kept |
| `rejected` | `core` | the case closed with its candidate rejected on a false keep claim |
| `proposed` | `core` | the case closed with its candidate proposed to a person, because it leaves the loop's surface |

## Decisions

Category `decision_name`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `explicitly_declined` | `core` | a recorded decision not to carry out the case's intent |
| `explicitly_superseded` | `core` | a recorded decision that another case replaces this one |
| `explicitly_abandoned` | `core` | a recorded decision to stop the case before it reaches any planned outcome |
| `explicitly_inconclusive` | `core` | a recorded decision that the case's evidence settles nothing |

## Case inputs

Category `case_input`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `risk` | `core` | how much proof a case must carry, fixed when it opens; it selects the obligations that apply |
| `change_kind` | `software.change` | what a change to software is, fixed when its case opens; it selects whether a regression must be reproduced first |
| `affects_security_boundary` | `core` | whether a change affects a security boundary, fixed when its case opens; one that does needs an independent security review |

## Input values

Category `input_value`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trivial` | `core` | the lowest risk; a change whose tests must pass and nothing more |
| `standard` | `core` | the usual risk; everything trivial requires, and review |
| `elevated` | `core` | a raised risk; everything standard requires, and a proven release |
| `critical` | `core` | the highest risk; everything elevated requires, and a healthy deployment |
| `feature` | `software.change` | a change that adds or alters behaviour |
| `bugfix` | `software.change` | a change that repairs a regression, which a failing test must reproduce before the implementation is edited |
| `refactor` | `software.change` | a change to the implementation that keeps its behaviour |
| `true` | `core` | the value of a yes-or-no case input when what it asks holds |
| `false` | `core` | the value of a yes-or-no case input when what it asks does not hold |

## Independence dimensions

Category `independence_dimension`.

| Term | Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `different_principal` | `core` | the producer of a record is another principal than the one who did the case's work |
| `different_agent_run` | `core` | the producer of a record is another agent run than the one that did the case's work |
